interactions.name: Primary input
interactions.trigger: Pointer activation of the demonstrated primary control
interactions.response: The product advances from the entry surface into the task
interactions.cancellation: Move away without activating the control
interactions.failure: No activation leaves the entry state unchanged
interactions.recovery: Return to the visible control and activate it

interactions.name: Focus and selection
interactions.trigger: Select the demonstrated item, field, or workspace target
interactions.response: The target becomes the active context
interactions.feedback: Selection styling or an active detail surface is visible
interactions.failure: An unselected target does not advance the workflow

interactions.name: Navigation
interactions.response: The central product surface changes while application context remains
interactions.feedback: Destination content replaces the prior surface
interactions.failure: A wrong destination shows content unrelated to the goal
interactions.recovery: Navigate back to the demonstrated destination

interactions.name: Configuration
interactions.trigger: Enter or choose the demonstrated task parameters
interactions.response: The product reflects the configured values
interactions.feedback: The in-progress state exposes the chosen configuration
interactions.cancellation: Remove or replace the current choice
interactions.failure: An incomplete configuration cannot produce the shown result

interactions.name: Confirmation
interactions.trigger: Activate the demonstrated commit, create, run, send, or save action
interactions.feedback: The surface transitions toward the result
interactions.cancellation: Back out before the commit action
interactions.failure: Committing with the task incomplete leaves a no-result state
interactions.recovery: Complete the required context and confirm again

interactions.name: Backtracking
interactions.trigger: Return from the current detail or configuration surface
interactions.response: The previous product context is restored
interactions.failure: Leaving too early abandons the pending result
interactions.recovery: Re-enter the demonstrated task from the restored context

interactions.name: System feedback
interactions.trigger: Wait after the demonstrated committed action
interactions.response: The first meaningful result becomes visible
interactions.feedback: Result content replaces or augments the in-progress state
interactions.cancellation: No cancellation is shown after completion
interactions.failure: Stopping before feedback provides no completion evidence
interactions.recovery: Wait for the visible result state

interactions.name: Failure and recovery
interactions.trigger: Attempt to proceed without the demonstrated selection or context
interactions.response: The workflow remains incomplete rather than reaching the result
interactions.feedback: The expected result state is absent
interactions.cancellation: Return to the preceding stable surface
interactions.recovery: Restore the demonstrated context and repeat the confirmed action

motion_analysis.trigger: Nothing the viewer does: the clip is an official screen-recorded walkthrough that plays itself. Inside it a drawn pointer performs the actions — it clicks the "Location 2nd Street Location" chip at 64.5s, picks "Austin Ecosystem" from the opened list at 66.5s, and travels down the left navigation (Home, Items & services, Online, Reports, Banking, POS systems) from 84s to 89s.
motion_analysis.start_state: Black title card reading "Navigate Your Dashboard & Locate Reports" with the white Square logo bottom-right (0-4s).
motion_analysis.end_state: Square Dashboard home for 2nd Street Location with the Performance date chip reading "Last year" and the pointer resting on "POS systems" at the foot of the left navigation (89-90.06s).
motion_analysis.continuity: One 90.06s render at ~30 fps. Scenes are joined by hard cuts and cross-dissolves: the black title card cuts to a "Topics" card at ~5s, the topics list grows line by line ("Homepage Overview" and "Features & Settings" by 14.4s, "Data & Reports" added by 16s), and the monitor mock-up dissolves into the full-bleed browser dashboard at ~19-20s. Within a scene motion is continuous — the pointer glides, menus slide open, and after each data change the cards pass through grey skeleton placeholders (63.5s, 67.0-67.5s) before values render. No still-image interpolation.
motion_analysis.interruption_or_reversal: Yes: at ~62.6s the pointer clicks the back arrow beside "Reports" in the report sub-navigation, the sub-navigation collapses back to the main sidebar by 62.75s and the Reports detail is replaced by the Home dashboard, which reloads through skeleton placeholders at 63.5s and finishes at ~63.75s.
motion_analysis.feedback: Every action draws a visible answer. Opening the location chip at 65.0s reveals a "Filter Locations" search field over a list (2nd Street Location, Austin Ecosystem, Aux fleurs de la bergerie, Best Cut Nickname, Main Street Location, Market Street, Retail - Florist); the hovered row is highlighted at 66.5s; the chip then reads "Austin Ecosystem" at 67.0s and every Key Metrics figure reloads to $0.00 and 0 by 68.0s. On the Reports page a spinner shows at ~59s and is replaced by the rendered bar-and-area chart under the "Jan 1, 2024-Dec 31, 2024" heading by ~59.5s.

observations: Every left-navigation entry pairs its icon with a text label (Home, Appointments, Items & services, Orders & payments, Online, Customers, Reports, Staff, Banking, Settings, POS systems), so the destination is readable without relying on the glyph (media/state-02-progress.jpg).

Trend direction is carried by both a numeral and a word-free but signed badge rather than by motion: Net Sales $339.93 with a green up-triangle 126.77%, Gross Sales $399.93 with 128.74%, Average Net Sale $33.99 with 240.16%, and Transactions 10 with a red down-triangle 33.33% are all legible in the still frame (media/state-02-progress.jpg, 45.03s).

The active date filter is spelled out in a chip rather than implied by chart shape, and it changes wording between retained frames: "Date Jan 1, 2024 - Dec 31, 2024" at 45.03s (media/state-02-progress.jpg) versus "Date Last year" at 75.65s (media/state-03-result.jpg).

In the header crop of media/state-02-progress.jpg (x 120-192, y 35-49) the brightest 2% of pixels (255,255,255) against the darkest 2% (60,60,60) measure an 11.03:1 luminance contrast ratio for the "Welcome back." heading, and the primary-button crop (x 120-170, y 55-68) measures 5.4:1 for the white "Go to Balance" label (254,255,251) on its indigo fill (90,97,188). Both computed with the WCAG relative-luminance formula over the retained JPEG.

State survives the animation being stopped: location, greeting, setup progress ("You're 80% set up."), date filter, every metric value and the Payment Types breakdown (Cash $134.21, Other $5.99, Card $0.00) are all text in the retained frames.
The current navigation item is marked by a filled light-blue row behind the label, not by an animated indicator, and the same highlight follows the pointer down the sidebar between 84s and 89s.
unknowns: Screen-reader names, roles, and live-region announcements were not exposed by the static-source recording.
Complete keyboard traversal and focus order were not established by the recording.
Reduced-motion preference handling and a nonanimated equivalent were not demonstrated.
